info.name: ReqRes Agent Sandbox API
info.description:
OpenAPI specification for the ReqRes API. Covers legacy demo endpoints, collections, app-user auth flows, custom endpoints, and the Agent Sandbox (/agent/v1/*) for AI coding agents. All /api/* endpoints require x-api-key. All /app/* endpoints require Authorization: Bearer . /agent/v1/* endpoints are open in v1 (IP-based rate limiting).

Contact Support:
 Name: ReqRes Support
 Email: hello@reqres.in

request.description: Lightweight health check that returns sandbox status, version, uptime, and the caller's current rate-limit status. Cached at the edge for 10 seconds. Cheap to poll. Send the optional x-agent-id header to elevate to Agent Developer tier limits.

item.name: ReqRes Get a Single Agent User with Optional Expansion

request.description: Returns one user. Without ?expand=, nested resources (addresses, activity, organizations) are returned as references. With ?expand=addresses,activity, those resources are inlined.

query.description: Opaque cursor from previous response. Omit for first page.

request.description: Paginated user list with realistic edge cases: nullable nested fields, sparse fieldsets, silent param clamping. Use meta.next_cursor for next page; never increment a page number.

item.name: ReqRes Agent Auth Login (with MFA Branch)

request.description: Returns a session for normal accounts or an MFA challenge for accounts with email matching '+mfa@'. Use '+wrong@' or '+locked@' suffixes to trigger 401 branches.
Orders with relational references (customer, line items, products, addresses). Money is always {amount, currency, formatted}. Some line_items reference deleted products.

item.name: ReqRes Trigger a Deliberate Failure Scenario

request.description: Returns a controlled failure for testing agent error handling. All responses include header X-Agent-Sandbox-Intentional: so error reporters can suppress them. Available scenarios: rate-limited, server-error, bad-gateway, timeout, validation-error, unauthorized, forbidden, not-found, conflict, too-large, slow, partial-content, redirect-loop, malformed-json, empty-response.

response.name: Not-found scenario or unknown scenario name
Timeout scenario (returns immediately, see X-Agent-Sandbox-Simulated-Delay header)

request.description: Returns the catalogue of available failure scenarios.
